description:
List phone numbers

Returns the phone numbers the account rents, newest purchase first. Wholesale costs, carrier identifiers and SIP credentials are never included, only the columns of the PhoneNumber schema. A reseller key sees every number belonging to its own customers and can narrow the result to one customer with `userId`; a direct account key ignores `userId` and always sees only its own numbers. `pagination.total` is a real count of every number matching the request, not the length of the page, so a page count can be computed from it.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.

userId.description: Reseller keys only: restrict the result to one customer account. The customer must belong to the calling reseller, otherwise the request is rejected with 403. Ignored for direct account keys.
